name: Darkness Given Hunger

alignment.name: Chaotic Evil
alignment.description:
Chaotic evil creatures have a complete disregard for others. They kill, steal, and betray others to gain power. Their word is meaningless and their actions destructive. Their worldviews can be so warped that they destroy anything and anyone that doesn’t directly contribute to their interests.
	By the standards of good and lawful good people, chaotic evil is as abhorrent as evil, perhaps even more so. Chaotic evil monsters such as demons and orcs are at least as much of a threat to civilization and general well-being as evil monsters are. An evil creature and a chaotic evil creature are both opposed to good, but they don’t have much respect for each other either and rarely cooperate toward common goals.
	For the purpose of game effects, a chaotic evil creature is also considered evil.

description: Creatures larger than Medium take up more than 1 square. For instance, an ogre takes up a space that is 2 squares by 2 squares. Most Large and larger creatures also have a reach greater than 1, which means they can make melee attacks against creatures that aren’t adjacent to them. A creature’s basic body shape usually determines its reach; a Large ogre has a reach of 2, but a Large horse has a reach of 1.

traits.name: Horrific Stench
traits.details: Any enemy that uses an attack power while in the aura takes 10 poison damage, or 20 poison damage while the ooze is bloodied.

traits.name: Ooze
traits.details: While squeezing, the ooze moves at full speed rather than half speed, it doesn’t take the -5 penalty to attack rolls, and it doesn’t grant combat advantage for squeezing.

auras.name: Horrific Stench
auras.details: Any enemy that uses an attack power while in the aura takes 10 poison damage, or 20 poison damage while the ooze is bloodied.

effect.description: The ooze shifts up to its speed.

hit.description: acid damage, the ooze pulls the target up to 4 squares, and the target is grabbed (escape DC 28).

effect.description: One creature grabbed by the ooze takes 4d12 + 22 acid damage and loses a healing surge. If the target has no healing surges, it takes 30 extra acid damage.

powers.name: Variable Resistance
powers.trigger: The ooze takes cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage.

effect.description: The ooze gains resist 20 to the triggering damage type until the end of the encounter or until it uses variable resistance again.

powers.name: Demonic Rebirth
powers.trigger: The ooze drops to 0 hit points.

effect.description: The ooze is destroyed, and an enraged hezrou appears in its space and uses slam as a free action. It then rolls initiative and acts on its turn.
